name: Musabori
source:
Our guy went on a special trip. He arrived on an island and is told the rules of this trip. He has to have fun with one girl a day for four days. At the end of four days, he gets to pick which girl he wants to keep.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公参加了一趟特别旅行。抵达一座岛屿后，他得知了旅程规则：连续4天，每天与1名女孩尽情玩乐。4天结束时，他可以从中选择一名女孩留在身边。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
